results.title: Haze Worsens As Two Sarawak Areas Record Very Unhealthy API
results.description: Haze conditions remained a concern this afternoon, with two areas in Sarawak recording very unhealthy Air Pollutant Index (API) readings. Meanwhile, 29 other areas nationwide registered unhealthy air quality as of 4 pm today. According to the Air Pollutant Index Management System (APIMS), Sri Aman recorded an API reading of 229.
